items.headline: U.S. Equities Rally as Fed Signals Patience on Rates, Despite Rising Oil Prices
items.summary: U.S. stock markets posted broad gains on Thursday, September 3, 2026, driven by growing optimism that the Federal Reserve may hold interest rates steady at its upcoming meeting. Remarks from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller, indicating a willingness to support holding rates if inflation data improves, spurred the rally and led to a notable decline in Treasury yields. However, escalating geopolitical tensions between the U.S. and Iran continued to push oil prices higher, adding to existing inflationary concerns. This report is for informational purposes only and not financial advice.

items.headline: ChargePoint Holdings Surges on Strong Earnings
items.summary: ChargePoint Holdings ($CHPT) rocketed 52% higher after the electric vehicle charging network operator surpassed Wall Street's second-quarter earnings forecasts. The company reported a substantial 18% year-over-year revenue increase to $116 million and a narrower-than-expected adjusted loss, along with a record non-GAAP gross margin of 38%.

items.headline: Snowflake Jumps on Blowout Q2 Results and AI Demand
items.summary: Cloud-based AI data platform company Snowflake ($SNOW) soared nearly 22% after delivering better-than-expected second-quarter results and providing an upbeat outlook. Artificial intelligence (AI) demand was cited as a significant driver for its business performance.

items.headline: Dell Technologies Upbeat on Strong Q2 Performance
items.summary: Dell Technologies ($DELL) jumped 15.8% after reporting quarterly adjusted earnings per share and revenue that exceeded analyst estimates, coupled with an optimistic future outlook.

items.headline: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical Plummets on Failed Drug Trial
items.summary: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical ($RARE) cratered 44% today after announcing that its pivotal Phase 3 Aspire study for apazunersen (GTX-102) in Angelman syndrome did not meet its primary or key secondary endpoints, raising significant concerns about the drug's future.

items.headline: Victoria's Secret & Co. Tumbles on Missed Earnings and Weak Guidance
items.summary: Victoria's Secret & Co. ($VSXY) tumbled 12.1% after the lingerie and beauty retailer missed Wall Street's second-quarter earnings expectations and subsequently provided full-year earnings guidance that fell below consensus estimates.

items.headline: Ciena Corp. Declines Despite Earnings Beat Amid Supply Constraints
items.summary: Telecommunications company Ciena Corp. ($CIEN) fell 11% despite reporting third-quarter earnings and revenue that exceeded analyst forecasts. The decline was attributed to ongoing supply constraints impacting investor sentiment.

items.headline: Broadcom Shares Dip on Soft Q4 Revenue Forecast
items.summary: Broadcom ($AVGO) shares dropped 4% after the chipmaker's fiscal fourth-quarter revenue forecast fell short of analyst expectations, overshadowing its better-than-expected second-quarter results.

items.headline: Fed's Waller Hints at Pause in Rate Hikes, Easing Market Fears
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller offered a dovish stance on monetary policy, stating he would be 'inclined to support' holding interest rates steady at the next Federal Open Market Committee meeting. This depends on upcoming inflation data continuing to show improvement, a sentiment that significantly reduced market expectations for a September rate hike.

items.headline: Oil Prices Climb Further Amid Intensifying US-Iran Conflict
items.summary: Global crude oil prices continued their ascent, with Brent crude nearing $97 per barrel and WTI crude topping $92, driven by an escalation in geopolitical tensions between the United States and Iran. The renewed fighting adds to inflationary pressures and remains a key focus for market participants.

items.headline: U.S. Trade Deficit Widens in July; Census Bureau Releases 2024 AIES Data
items.summary: The U.S. goods and services trade deficit increased in July 2026, rising to $88.6 billion from $71.2 billion in June, as imports grew and exports declined. Additionally, the U.S. Census Bureau today released the comprehensive dataset from its 2024 Annual Integrated Economic Survey (AIES), providing a detailed economic snapshot of U.S. employer businesses.

items.headline: Technology and Communication Services Lead Market Gains on AI Optimism
items.summary: The Technology and Communication Services sectors were prominent leaders in today's market rally, heavily influenced by strong performance from major tech companies and continued optimism surrounding artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure demand and advancements. Companies like Nvidia ($NVDA) gained on news of AI-related acquisitions.
